svg.title: Figure 2. Four conditions that change an AI recommendation
svg.desc: A two-by-two grid, one quadrant per condition, each with two sourced findings shown as mini-charts. System and configuration: doctors matching a real clinician, web search off 10.8% vs on 63.9% (Ibrahim and Zaki, preprint); AI Overviews and Gemini source overlap 0.07 for near-me queries (Grossman et al.). Place: real doctors named without search, largest third of metros 16.3% vs smallest 9.5% (Ibrahim and Zaki); 3.5% of businesses ChatGPT named appeared at every point tested in a town (BrightLocal). Wording and context: oculoplastic specialists 74.7% for 'an oculoplastic surgeon' vs 46.6% for 'a doctor who does eyelid lifts' (Parikh et al.); ChatGPT declined to recommend an orthopedic surgeon in 52.8% of responses (Haupt et al.). Time: overlap with answers two weeks later 0.375 (Pitenin, preprint); median 29% of businesses named in both of two ChatGPT answers about 39 minutes apart (8ight.AI). Values are not comparable across findings.
